what_it_is: Pokemon Diamond save 100% game completed. Some shinies, All Starters

gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 512 KiB flash (padded 262144 -> 524288 with 0xFF)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 524288 --stem 'Pokemon - Diamond Version (Europe) (Rev 5)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 524288-byte chip (padded 262144 -> 524288 with 0xFF) and writes each core's file

desmume.detail: CONTINUE: PLAYER Ash, TIME 24:49, BADGES 8, POKéDEX 493 (run in the Diamond (Europe) (Rev 5) image, game code ADAE, which the USA release shares)

melonds.detail: "A communication error has occurred" ("... you will be returned to wherever you last saved") instead of the CONTINUE panel, then a white screen; melonDS 0.9.3 does the same with its own Pearl save from this corpus, so it is the core (no BIOS or firmware here, FreeBIOS), not this save

note: Release: Diamond/Pearl layout, English; Diamond from the version that caught the player's own Pokemon (origin game in the decrypted Pokemon data, OT matching the trainer) (some Pearl catches too) and the description. The library's image of this game code is the Pokemon - Diamond Version (Europe) (Rev 5) release; the save was run in it, since both releases share the game code.
